items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: But it seems as though Charlie Johnson would usually go down there in the summer but we got the job.

ctx.x: Would you be asking musical questions?

Musical. I'd ask him various questions of this. And he said, I've lived in Europe, I've lived in (inaudible). He'd explain it to me. And then if I wouldn't ask him no more, I wouldn't get no more. But I was there everyday, beggin him, or as we said bugging him, but I was learning. I was a little bit dumb so that was why I was asking questions. I didn't want to stay dumb.

Now, we were rehearsing the group, Monte Carlo, we were playing, "Time Goes," "Passez Doubles" (PHONETIC). We had that type of band. And it was beautiful. Then we got a job to go to Atlantic City. (Inaudible) one of the clubs at Atlantic City. But it seems as though Charlie Johnson would usually go down there in the summer but we got the job. And oh, we had a beautiful time, man.
